title: Microsoft: "Writing Code Manually Has Become Obsolete". AI Is Changing Programmer Work
content_md:
Microsoft: "Writing Code Manually Has Become Obsolete". AI Is Changing Programmer Work

Microsoft has stated that manual code writing is becoming obsolete as AI transforms the way programmers work. The company argues that AI-assisted development tools are fundamentally changing software development workflows and that developers who do not adapt to AI-assisted coding risk falling behind.

This statement reflects a broader industry trend where major technology companies are increasingly positioning AI coding assistants as essential tools for software development. Microsoft has been investing heavily in AI-powered development tools through its partnership with OpenAI and integration of Copilot across its development ecosystem.

The implications for cybersecurity are significant: as AI takes on more coding tasks, the nature of vulnerabilities and attack surfaces may shift. AI-generated code introduces new categories of security concerns, while simultaneously AI tools can be used to identify and remediate vulnerabilities faster than manual review processes.

Source: https://www.redhotcyber.com/post/microsoft-scrivere-codice-manualmente-e-diventato-obsoleto-lia-sta-cambiando-il-lavoro-dei-programmatori/
